title: The Bible

videos.title: Go Fish - The B-I-B-L-E - Great Music For Kids!

textBlocks:
Hello Boys and Girls
Today we are talking about a very special book that 
God gave us
THE BIBLE
The Bible is very special 
it is God’s letter to us.
In it, He tells us everything we need to know about how to live on the earth.

What to believe
How to act
How to talk
How to be saved

Have you ever made a Lego helicopter with an instruction sheet?
Or have you ever gone to the zoo and needed a MAP, or on a long walk?
Well the Bible is like a MAP and an INSTRUCTION sheet
It tells us what to do so that we don’t get lost and do the wrong things.
THE BIBLE TELLS US 
how to live here on earth and how much God loves us.
